comment_regular: Verified TravelPath_ComputeDistance sums Euclidean segments from sourceRef->GetPos through each TravelPathNode_GetPosition. For a type-0 teleport node, the segment endpoint is the linked door's TeleportData xyz marker; after consuming that node, the next segment starts at the current door's own TeleportData xyz (its destination marker). Type-1 nodes use owned position payloads; ordinary references use GetPos.
